input.title: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'length') on redo categorize
input.body:
It is had to pinpoint the cause from the stack track because it bubbles up from an async YJS update. However, the error goes away when `updateLexeme` is temporarily disabled, so that is a clue.

It's possible that this will not be an issue with the new sync engine when Lexemes are just indexes and do not require such complex coordination with Thoughts.

## Steps to Reproduce

1. Create an empty thought.
2. Categorize
3. Categorize
4. Undo
5. Undo
6. Redo
7. Redo

## Current Behavior

`Error: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'length')`

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/cdf8c2e7-5d35-4e5b-82ff-74a26b7dda99

## Expected Behavior

No error and redo the second Categorize.
